# Functional Design Questions — U2 Pick-up slots

## Question 1: Moving an order to another slot

Can a customer move an order once it is placed?

A. Yes, to any free slot, until 21:00 the evening before.
B. No; they cancel and order again.
X. Other (please specify)

**Proposed:** B. Fewer rules to build.

[Answer]: A

## Question 2: A full slot

What does a full slot look like?

A. Shown, marked full, and not pickable.
B. Hidden.
X. Other (please specify)

**Proposed:** A. People see why they cannot pick it.

[Answer]: A
